operator.description: Map a European option contract and an evaluation coordinate to the Black-Scholes solution.
operator.theta_convention: calendar-time derivative per year, equal to -dV/dtau

splits.train: Synthetic contracts and coordinates used for fitting.
splits.validation: Independent synthetic contracts used for model selection.
splits.test: The frozen common benchmark cases; never used for fitting or model selection.

fixed_surface.purpose: Direct comparison with the frozen anchored PINN

parameterized_contracts.purpose: Full comparison of DeepONet with analytical and classical methods

data_policy.reason: Market prices include model mismatch, liquidity effects and observation noise and are not exact Black-Scholes solution labels.
